clauses.title: V.A.1 Threat model
clauses.text: Document a product threat model that describes the system, assets, trust boundaries, and relevant cybersecurity threats.

clauses.title: V.A.2 Cybersecurity risk assessment
clauses.text: Assess cybersecurity risks to the device and related systems, including identified risks, controls, residual risks, and the rationale for risk decisions.

clauses.title: V.A.4 Software bill of materials
clauses.text: Provide a machine-readable software bill of materials and, for each component, its support status and end-of-support date; if unavailable, explain why it cannot be included.

clauses.title: V.A.5 Unresolved software anomalies assessment
clauses.text: Assess unresolved software anomalies that could affect device safety or effectiveness, document their impact and risk, and explain how they are addressed or why they remain open.

clauses.title: V.B.2 Security architecture views
clauses.text: Provide security architecture views that explain the device and related systems, their security-relevant interactions, and how identified risks are addressed.

clauses.title: V.C Cybersecurity testing
clauses.text: Provide the cybersecurity requirements and acceptance criteria and document testing that demonstrates the security controls were implemented and tested effectively.

clauses.title: VI.B Cybersecurity management plan
clauses.text: Describe how postmarket vulnerabilities will be monitored, identified, addressed, and communicated, including responsible roles, update timelines, and coordinated disclosure procedures.

clauses.title: VII.C.1 Plans and procedures
clauses.text: Provide a plan to monitor, identify, and address postmarket vulnerabilities and exploits in a reasonable time, including coordinated vulnerability disclosure and related procedures.

clauses.title: VII.C.2 Cybersecurity processes and procedures
clauses.text: Document the processes used to design, develop, and maintain cybersecurity for the device and related systems, including their risks and controls.

clauses.title: VII.C.3 Software bill of materials
clauses.text: Provide a software bill of materials for the cyber device and include component support status and end-of-support dates.
